strings.en: 1. Destroy all enemies
1. All allies destroyed
Sh-Shinobu!
Tch! What the hell is this!? The Cyber Beast Force base!?
Commander Hazuki... what is this!?
I-I don't know... but...!
It didn't look like this when I attacked it...
I sense the presence of an aura full of malice...
Is this really... the Cyber Beast Force base?
Looks like something rose up from deep under the base...
Like that... our Far East Branch is...
It's not going to function as a base... not anymore.
According to the report right after things went wrong, everyone inside
managed to evacuate somehow, but...
What on earth caused this?
We have to investigate...
No need for that.
What do you mean, Fujiwara...?
He means we can guess without looking into it, right?
Only one guy could pull off a stunt like this.
Him... Surely not... Surely he's not really...
That's right.
Here he comes already!
Is everyone ready to sortie!?
Ready anytime, Amuro!
Just let us launch already!
We just settled things with Mykene, and Tetsuya's already...
All hands, sortie!
It's been a while... Fools who falsely claim the name of god!
...No doubt about it. It's you...!
Muge...
Zorbados...!
I knew you were still alive! Muge, you bastard!
What the hell are you after!?
I am the universe itself... I shall guide you foolish humans into my world!
The universe itself? Don't make me laugh! You're just an invader!
An invader...? Heh heh heh, ha ha ha ha ha!
What's so funny!
Do you truly... believe I am a mere invader...?
Foolish... Utterly foolish, you humans...!
What an infuriating bastard!
What's going on!? Why are the Einst here?
Are you saying the Muge Empire and the Einst series are connected?
Come to think of it, weren't they together on the Dirad planet too?
What are you scheming!? Answer me, Muge, you bastard!
Heh heh heh... Think on it... Why the Einst would aid me...
and seek to destroy you all...
That's what we're asking you! Answer us!
Enough talk... You who disturb the silence of the universe...!
Don't come stomping into our home and then act all high and mighty!
Let's do it!
Heh heh heh heh heh... So you're still alive... all of you.
...What!?
You!? Weren't you defeated in the battle on the plant planet?
I didn't figure it'd be... that easy, though.
I knew it... I knew you were still alive... Shapirooooo!
...Heh heh. You stopped the Dirad landing... I'll say that was well done.
Like we'd ever let something like that crash into us!
But... it seems you don't understand what is about to happen...
to this Earth.
What's that supposed to mean!?
Sara, looking at that base, can you tell what is about to happen?
Who knows? Not a clue. Nothing you do ever makes any sense!
That... is the shadow of Emperor Muge.
Shadow?
You mean it's not Emperor Muge himself?
Flaunting his presence, even if only as a shadow? How simple.
Heh... Otherwise you would have died without ever laying eyes
on the form of Lord Muge...
You're awfully cocky. Is it 'cause you've got the Einst backing you up?
Heh...
What's with that smirk!? What's that supposed to mean!?
You'll find out in time... if you live that long...
"If we live"!? Quit messing with us!
We've still got a mountain of stuff left to do!
We can't die in a place like this!
Struggle all you like... But in the end, I'm the one who will laugh...
Sara... Even after seeing the form of Emperor Muge,
do you still intend to side with these Earthlings?
Showing me that thing's no reason to go over to your side, Shapiro.
Heh... In the end, you're a lowly Earthling too... You can't see it, Sara.
Shut up!
She's a hell of a lot better than a guy who brags he's gonna become a god!
Ngh...
No! Fujiwara!
Heh heh heh... How pathetic, Fujiwara...
Grrgh...
Shinobu!?
Shinobu, answer me!
Hey! Shinobu!
Shinobu!
Ngh... Sara...?
Shinobu... are you okay...!?
Yeah, more or less... Everyone... all right?
Yeah.
Damn, my eyes... are getting blurry.
Don't just space out on me! ...I... I...
I'll finish this... Dancougar! And Sara!
You betrayed me time and again... I will not forgive you!
Shapiro... I...
At last... the hated Dancougar... Heh heh heh... Ha ha ha ha ha ha ha!
Screw you! Shapiro! Muge, you bastard!
What!? What's this surge of aura!?
I feel it too! Show!
What's happening!? Are Fujiwara and the others all right!?
Dancougar's... glowing!? Hey! Fujiwara!
Dancougar's power!?
...The Danku Sword... is burning...!?
Raaaaagh!!
This is... the Danku Koga Sword...! Formation D-3...
without the Gandoll Cannon!? Fujiwara... you're really something!
Sara! Ryo! Masato! Let's go!!
Shinobu! Don't screw this up!!
Let's go!!
Gooooo!!
We'll be reborn as warriors of the gods!
Danku Koga Sword now available.
This power...! I see... Beyond machine, man, even beast... to become a god...!
Is that the power of Dancougar!?
Shinobu... you really are something...
Reason... has surpassed the wild...? I cannot win this battle...
He ran, huh...
But it's still...!
No way... Even after an attack like that... it's still in one piece...
What a monster...
There's no need to worry... That is now... nothing more than a lump.
What's that s'posed to mean?
Its presence... is gone...
Huh!? Hey, you're right!
Cham, what is it?
It's like it turned into... an empty shell?
The aura of malice... has vanished.
Queen Sheela, then...?
That object... has become nothing but lifeless matter...!
So it wasn't the real thing.
Could it have been something like a terminal...?
What Fujiwara cut down was the shadow of Muge Zorbados...
So Muge himself is somewhere, waiting for the time of his revival...
Heh heh... Strong, as expected. I'll be withdrawing for now!
The bastard's making a run for it!
Get back here! Quit scurrying around!
Shapiro... Why do you always...!
The chance... for me to become a god has come around again, Sara...!
There's no need to rush... This is just the start. It all begins now!
Heh heh heh heh, hah ha ha ha ha ha ha...
Ngh...
What a guy...
At running away, he is FIRST-CLASS!
Is something wrong, Queen Sheela?
Well... Lady Elle, didn't you sense it?
I did.
Just now, the malicious aura from that so-called shadow of Muge vanished...
Yeah, it vanished right when that Shapiro guy disappeared.
That is now nothing more than a lump...
So he got away...
And he left this junk behind!
If you're gonna vanish, at least put things back the way they were first!
Still, why would he need to do something like this...?
Maybe he wanted to make his presence known...?
To show that Emperor Muge is as strong as ever...
So Muge Zorbados's revival is near... is that it?
Is it over!?
What about the Muge shadow fused with the Cyber Beast Force base!?
It's the same as before.
...It's just a heap of rock and steel... what looks like the base's materials.
Is the scary thing all gone now?
To think Muge Zorbados would return at a time like this...
And... the Einst worry me, too.
Muge and Shapiro... They were saying some meaningful things...
Shapiro...
Sara...
We really know so very little, don't we?
Whatever they're after... they're still the enemy...
Anyway, for now we'll just have to deal with the enemies we know about.
A positive outlook. Yes, we can only advance one step at a time.
Tetsuya and the others may be pulling something reckless. Let's hurry!
I'm not Koji, but... I'm a little worried too.
That's right. We've still gotta search for Akira's mom, too.
If I may, Commander Hazuki?
The Gran Garan and Goraon will be heading to the next point.
Please do.
